row.title: UPTIME-1: a nameserver move looks like an outage until resolver caches expire; probe every hostname
row.body: 2026-11-21: ultrastable.org gave DNS errors after the four zones moved to the ultrastable account (old zones in the quniverse account are moved; resolvers kept the old nameservers). Zones, records and custom domains were already correct. One real defect: www.ultrastable.app returned 404 because the wildcard route of ultrastable-spinoffs won; site/wrangler.toml now declares the specific route. Worker ultrastable-uptime probes 9 hostnames every 5 minutes over two DoH resolvers plus HTTPS, retries once, and repairs through the tick Worker /api/uptime/repair (org GitHub App dispatches deploy-site.yml).
